payload.name: Audit codebase
payload.description: check codebase - audit the current state of the cred-vault Go project to understand its structure, verify there are no issues, and report findings

goal.answer: Perform a comprehensive audit of the cred-vault Go project's backend (Go) and frontend (JS/HTML/CSS), examining code structure, security posture, correctness, and code quality, then produce a findings report with specific file:line references and actionable recommendations.

criteria.answer:

`go vet ./...` is executed and its output is captured in the report.
The report includes an assessment of every source file in the project (Go backend, JS/HTML/CSS frontend, and configuration).
Any high-severity findings are flagged with specific file:line references and concise explanations.

phaseSnapshots.name: Audit & Report
phaseSnapshots.goal: Run automated checks, manually review every source file, and synthesize findings into a comprehensive report.
phaseSnapshots.description: Execute go vet, gofmt, and go build to capture automated analysis. Manually inspect each Go handler, vault crypto/storage logic, and the static frontend for security flaws, correctness issues, and code quality problems. Write all findings into .kimchi/docs/audit-report.md with file:line references, severity ratings, and recommendations.

steps.description: Run go vet ./..., gofmt -d ., and go build -o /tmp/cred-vault-test . to capture automated check output.
Manually review every source file for security, correctness, and quality issues.

assumptions.answer: The intent was unambiguous from orientation; no interview questions were needed.; "Issues" encompasses security vulnerabilities, correctness bugs, code quality concerns, and architectural observations.; The frontend (JS/HTML/CSS) is in scope since it is part of the single-page application.; The audit is read-only reporting; code fixes are out of scope unless explicitly requested by the user later.

payload.summary: Phase 1 'Audit & Report' completed successfully. All three steps were executed: (1) automated Go tooling (go vet, gofmt, go build) captured output, (2) manual security/correctness/quality review of all 10 source files, and (3) synthesis into a comprehensive audit report at .kimchi/docs/audit-report.md. No items were deferred.

grade.rationale: All gates pass; project checks validate.

payload.finalSummary: The 'Audit codebase' ferment is complete. A comprehensive audit of the cred-vault Go project was performed across all 10 source files. Automated checks (go vet, gofmt, go build) were run and captured. A manual security/correctness/quality review identified 2 critical, 4 high, 7 medium, 9 low, and 21 info findings. The synthesized report was written to .kimchi/docs/audit-report.md with specific file:line references and prioritized recommendations. Key critical findings: shell command injection in the SSH Connect handler and overly permissive CORS wildcard.
